title: CarbonLEI verification verdict
description: Output of `carbonlei verify --json` and of `verdictFor` in sdk/verdict.ts (format 2). Exit codes: 0 VALID, 1 INVALID, 2 CONTESTED, 3 error (the error object below), 4 INCOMPLETE. Check 8 is advisory: a warning does not change `overall`. Check 9 (precursors) and `precursors` appear only for a proof whose credential commits to a precursor statement or that carries precursor evidence.

id.description: Check number (sdk/verify.ts): 0 structure, 1 SAID, 2 disclosures, 3 signature, 4 on-chain report, 5 shipment, 6 KEL anchor, 7 authority chain, 8 reconciliation (advisory), 9 precursors (only for a proof with a precursor part; its PRECURSOR_WARNING codes are advisory), 10 carbon price paid (only for a proof with carbon price evidence; draft CBAM Art 9 rules, not adopted, illustrative; its CARBON_PRICE_WARNING codes are advisory).

code.description: Failure or warning code, for example DISCLOSURE_TAMPERED; empty on pass.

rules.description: Check 8 sub-rules on the verification report (sdk/verification-rules.ts, rule set carbonlei-verification-rules/1): report dates, site visit, accreditation at the report date and, with an accreditation registry, the verifier's provenance. A sub-rule fails only when the report extract is the one the auditor signed; note is information only.

overall.description: INCOMPLETE: no check failed and nothing is CONTESTED, but check 6 or 7 did not pass or fail (not run without an evidence checker, or only a warning from a caller's own checker), or the credential commits to a precursor statement that check 9 did not decide; not a pass. CONTESTED also when check 9 found a precursor credential CONTESTED.

primaryCode.description: Code of the first failing check; empty when no check failed.

rejected.description: Disclosures presented but rejected by check 2.

disclosed.description: Field values that matched the signed credential.

chain.description: The chain and the block every on-chain read was pinned to; null when the run stopped before reading the chain (a malformed proof).

checkedAt.description: UNIX seconds used for checks 4 and 5: the shipment's claim time when check 5 bound the shipment to the given EORI, otherwise the block time.

warnings.description: How the checks were run, when the caller should know. SHIPMENT_NOT_BOUND: the proof has a shipment but no EORI was given, so check 5 was skipped and check 4 used the block time, not the claim time. EVIDENCE_NOT_CHECKED: check 6 or 7 did not pass or fail (not run, or only a warning from a caller's own checker); overall is then INCOMPLETE, unless a check failed (INVALID) or check 4 is CONTESTED (CONTESTED). RECONCILIATION_NOT_CHECKED: the credential commits to a signed reconciliation (its three hashes are in the core), but check 8 was not run or not decided (the report extract missing, different from the signed one, unreadable, or reconciled fields hidden), so the sub-rules on the signed report were not applied; overall is then INCOMPLETE unless a check failed or something is CONTESTED. PRECURSORS_NOT_CHECKED: the credential commits to a precursor statement, but check 9 was not run or not decided (the statement or a producer's proof not presented, or a producer's proof INCOMPLETE); overall is then INCOMPLETE unless a check failed or something is CONTESTED. CARBON_PRICE_NOT_CHECKED: the proof carries a carbon price statement, but check 10 was not run or not decided (no pinned exchange rate, the precursor it applies to not verified or its precursor statement not signed into the credential, no EORI or no shipment for a statement on the good itself); overall is then INCOMPLETE unless a check failed or something is CONTESTED.

trustAnchor.description: Root of trust AID check 7 was run with: the demo root unless --trust-anchor was given; null when the caller supplied its own checkers.

carbonPrice.description: Check 10's breakdown (sdk/carbonprice.ts CarbonPriceReport): the effective carbon price per tonne recomputed on the rules of the Commission's DRAFT implementing regulation on CBAM Art 9 (Ares(2026)4841230), not adopted: illustrative. `draft` always carries the label.

draft.const: Draft implementing act, not adopted — illustrative

precursors.description: Check 9 breakdown (sdk/precursor.ts PrecursorReport): SEE of the good = attributedDirect + the sum of massPerTonne × SEE of each precursor (Commission Guidance No. 3, section 4.2.2.3), compared with the declared value within `tolerance`, all in tCO2e per tonne of good.

signed.description: The statement's digest is in the good's signed credential core (precursorDigest); false: shown for information only, check 9 is then advisory.

verification.description: The producer's proof verification (checks 0–9), with check 5 bound to the good's supplier LEI.

error.description: Why the verification could not run (RPC failure, unreadable proof, bad option). Exit code 3.
